summary: Master hospitality finance with our 5-day course. Learn USALI standards, RevPAR optimization, and labor cost control to drive hotel profitability.
lede: Financial leadership in hospitality helps operations and finance professionals link property decisions to financial performance. The course covers revenue and profitability measures, labor productivity, food and beverage cost control, budgeting and rolling forecasts, variance analysis, capital planning, internal controls, and communicating results to owners and boards.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who oversee hospitality operations and must demonstrate high-level fiscal responsibility to owners and corporate boards.
modules: Strategic Hospitality Finance and USALI® Standards
Labor Productivity and Human Capital Engineering
Food and Beverage Financial Control Systems
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a hospitality management role with some exposure to departmental budgets. Familiarity with basic Excel functions and an understanding of hotel operations (Front Office, F&B, or Housekeeping) is required. Prior knowledge of the USALI® framework is beneficial but not mandatory.
